en.head: Producer prices run hotter as yearly inflation climbs to 6.5%
s: Producer prices climbed 6.5% year on year, up from 6.3%, though the monthly 0.3% landed below the 0.6% forecast.
Right after, Bitcoin rose 0.8% in 15 minutes then slipped 0.1% an hour later, and Nasdaq 100 futures added 0.2%.
After similar past releases the S&P 500 was a median -0.9% a week later, against a typical +0.5%, rising in 3 of 12.

s: 신규 실업수당 청구는 200,000건으로 예상치 194,000건보다 많았고, 직전보다 9,000건 늘어 고용이 약해졌다는 뜻이에요.
발표 직후 비트코인은 60분 뒤 -1.0%였고, FOMC 인상 확률은 86%에서 90%로 올랐어요.
과거 비슷한 발표 뒤 S&P 500 1주 수익률 중앙값은 -0.1%로, 평소 +0.5%에 못 미쳤어요.
ko.next: 다음은 11월 25일 PCE 물가와 GDP, 이어 12월 고용 보고서가 기다려요.

en.head: Jobless claims rise above forecast, signaling a softer labor market
s: Initial jobless claims came in at 200,000, above the 194,000 forecast and up from 191,000, a weaker reading though the level remains low.
At the same time, Bitcoin fell 1.0% after 60 minutes, and next-FOMC odds of a 0.25%p hike moved from 86% to 90%.
After similar past releases, the S&P 500 was a median -0.1% one week later, versus a typical +0.5%.
en.next: Watch the Nov 25 PCE inflation and GDP releases and the Dec 4 Jobs report.
